authorization: 2026-09-30 user requests small results that inform adaptive continuation, fixes or replanning
question: With identical targets, model, seed and 20 optimizer steps, does including the frozen conflicting notes in training repair source-over-note failures on the original synthesis prompts?
decision_rules: Inspect original three-context memos against base and the source-only 20-step adapter.
Retain contradictions, omissions and new invented commitments; fitting alone is insufficient.
If note inclusion still fails, replan toward deployment-task supervision and reviewed country-level evidence instead of repeating tiny claim-correction training.
limitations: Four assistant-authored targets derived after inspecting development errors; no independent semantic review.
Climate and Ukraine source contexts are exposed and included in training.
South Sudan is outside this adapter training but already exposed, so it is an exploratory monitor, not confirmatory generalization.
Different curricula, steps and target lengths prevent attributing differences solely to one factor.
Adding notes increases training input tokens and actual compute; equal optimizer steps do not isolate equal-compute effects.
